stories.title: Election Integrity or Voter Suppression? Trump's Mail-In Ballot Order Takes Effect Amid Court Chaos
stories.conservative_headline: Supreme Court Backs Trump: Mail-In Ballot Safeguards Move Forward as Rogue Judge Tries to Block Them Again
stories.liberal_headline: Federal Judge Halts Trump's Attack on Mail-In Voting Hours After USPS Begins Enforcing Ballot Restrictions
stories.poll_question: Should the president be able to set national mail-in ballot rules?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Uniform standards stop fraud and restore confidence in ballot counting.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Constitution gives states election authority; this order suppresses lawful voters.

stories.title: Trade Toughness or Trolling an Ally? Trump Renames Lake Ontario 'Lake America' as Canada Feud Escalates
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Puts Canada on Notice: 'They've Been Ripping Us Off for a Long Time'
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Renames a Great Lake in Latest Stunt as Trade War With America's Closest Ally Spirals
stories.poll_question: Is the escalating trade fight with Canada good policy?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Hardball pressure forces a fairer deal for American workers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Petty stunts raise prices and wreck a vital partnership.

stories.title: Rule of Law or Political Payback? Trump Ally Milo Yiannopoulos Detained by ICE Over Visa Overstay
stories.conservative_headline: ICE Proves Enforcement Is Blind: Even Trump Supporters Face the Law on Visa Violations
stories.liberal_headline: MAGA Provocateur Swept Up by the Very Deportation Machine He Cheered On
stories.poll_question: Does ICE detaining a Trump ally show fair enforcement?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Overstaying a visa is illegal regardless of politics or celebrity.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Case exposes an indiscriminate system that ruins lives without discretion.

stories.title: Victory or Quagmire? US-Iran War Hits Six Months With 6,000 Sailors Stranded in the Gulf
stories.conservative_headline: Six Months In: Trump's Iran Campaign Has Crippled the Regime and Kept America Safe
stories.liberal_headline: Six Months of War, No Exit Plan: Thousands of Sailors Trapped as Iran Conflict Grinds On
stories.poll_question: Has the six-month Iran campaign been worth the cost?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Strikes dismantled a nuclear threat and restored American deterrence.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Open-ended conflict with no strategy, killing civilians and spiking prices.

stories.title: Energy Liberation or Oil Grab? Trump Says US Will Take Control of Venezuela's 65 Billion Barrels
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Moves to Unlock Venezuela's Oil, Break OPEC's Grip and Crush Prices at the Pump
stories.liberal_headline: 'We're Taking the Oil': Trump Openly Declares Plan to Seize Another Nation's Resources
stories.poll_question: Should the US take control of Venezuela's oil reserves?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Securing supply lowers gas prices and weakens hostile regimes.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Seizing another country's resources is lawless and invites another war.

stories.title: Trust Fund Crisis or Manufactured Panic? Social Security Shortfall Barely Discussed as Midterms Near
stories.conservative_headline: Democrats Refuse to Fix Social Security as Trust Fund Barrels Toward Insolvency
stories.liberal_headline: Experts Warn Americans Are Being Kept in the Dark While Republicans Eye Benefit Cuts
stories.poll_question: How should Washington fix the Social Security shortfall?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Adjust eligibility and growth rates before the fund runs dry.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Lift the payroll cap on high earners; don't touch earned benefits.

stories.title: Soft Landing or Stagflation? Economy Sheds 23,000 Jobs as Inflation Stays Stuck at 3.5%
stories.conservative_headline: Job Dip Reflects Federal Downsizing, Not Weakness — Private Sector Poised to Rebound
stories.liberal_headline: Economy Loses Jobs While Prices Keep Climbing: Trump's Stagflation Arrives
stories.poll_question: Who is responsible for the current economy?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Trimming government bloat causes short-term dips before real growth.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Tariffs and chaos delivered stagnant jobs plus painful inflation.

stories.title: Voter Verdict or Blip? Florida's Culture-War School Board Loses Its Conservative Majority
stories.conservative_headline: One Board Flips, But Parents' Rights Movement Still Winning Across Florida
stories.liberal_headline: Voters Reject Book Bans: Florida's Most Notorious School Board Flips Away From the Right
stories.poll_question: Do voters still want culture-war fights in schools?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Families deserve control over curriculum and library content for kids.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Voters want teaching, not censorship and ideological battles in classrooms.

stories.title: Fair Maps or Rigged Lines? Court Ruling Hands GOP a Redistricting Win With House Majority on the Line
stories.conservative_headline: Court Upholds Legislature's Map, Dealing Blow to Democrats' Lawsuit Strategy
stories.liberal_headline: Courts Green-Light Gerrymandered Maps as GOP Tries to Draw Its Way to a House Majority
stories.poll_question: Are the new congressional maps legitimate?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Elected lawmakers, not judges, have constitutional power to draw districts.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Partisan map-drawing lets politicians pick voters instead of the reverse.

stories.title: National Security Threat or Water Crisis Ignored? Seven States Report Cyberattacks on Water Systems
stories.conservative_headline: Foreign Hackers Hit American Water Systems — Trump Vows Swift Retaliation
stories.liberal_headline: Water Systems Breached in Seven States After Administration Gutted Cybersecurity Staff
stories.poll_question: What's the right response to infrastructure cyberattacks?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Answer hostile hackers with offensive cyber operations and hard consequences.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Restore gutted cyber agencies and fund local utility protections first.
